Done = listed in VERIFIED and deps done and file contains no `sorry`.
Any `sorry` forces open/blocked regardless of VERIFIED.
Hard edge B→A: A imports B (direct, submodule files only; barrel omitted).
Drawn edges are transitively reduced; blocking still uses all direct imports.

Blue = done (proved, counterexample or refuted; no sorry). Green = open. Grey = blocked. Counterexample / refutation labels are shown as text on the node.

nodes.label: TheoremC: refuted by CounterExample_TheoremC

nodes.label: isStoppingTime_tauHit (047b221)
nodes.detail: Geometric grid t_n=T(1-2^{-n}) and hitting-time stopping lemma isStoppingTime_tauHit. Grid foundations in 99d7748; stopping lemma in 047b221.

nodes.label: increment independence & geometric decay (b74bd01)
nodes.detail: Independence of the standardized increments Z_n and geometric decay P(E_n)≤q^n, plus the early V_T=1 a.s. identity. Done in b74bd01.

nodes.label: doublingC_sq_integral_le (b63d981)
nodes.detail: L² bound on the doubling weights, E[∏_{j<m}(1-Z_j)²]=2^m, and the integrand / localizing-time packaging in bf9c194. Done in b63d981.

nodes.label: doublingWealth V_0=0, V_T=1, continuity (4c102ea)
nodes.detail: Explicit wealth process: starts at 0, ends at 1 almost surely, and almost every path is continuous on [0,T]. Done in 4c102ea.

nodes.label: Riemann-sum tools + pathwise convergence (5a32c82, b7cfba5)
nodes.detail: Left-point Riemann-sum tools for the doubling integrand (5a32c82) and pathwise convergence of indicator partition sums to the matching Brownian increment (b7cfba5).

nodes.label: isItoIntegral_doublingWealth (3fc4c9e)
nodes.detail: The doubling wealth is the Itô integral of K, with no glue parameters. Done in 3fc4c9e.

nodes.label: measurable_bmCoord_eval_le / adaptedness (024652f)
nodes.detail: B evaluated at a stopping time τ≤t is F_t-measurable (Mathlib stronglyMeasurable_stoppedValue_of_le); X_n and c_n are F_{t_n}-adapted. Dyadic helpers in f457b1e; lemma and adaptedness in 024652f.

nodes.label: predictability of K (024652f)
nodes.detail: Left-open stochastic intervals (t_n,τ_n] are predictable (1d57446); uncurry doublingK is a pointwise limit of those stopped blocks, hence predictable (024652f).

nodes.label: SAdmissible (024652f)
nodes.detail: IntegrableOn of K² on [0,T] a.s., hence the doubling strategy is S-admissible for S=σ=1. Done in 024652f.

nodes.label: theorem_literal_nflvr_fails (024652f)
nodes.detail: Literal NFLVR fails: the doubling strategy is admissible, V_T=1 a.s., and this is a nontrivial free lunch in the Delbaen–Schachermayer cone. Done in 024652f.

nodes.label: bsPrice continuous, positive, adapted (4d9d645)
nodes.detail: Closed-form Black–Scholes price s₀ exp(σ₀ B_t - ½ σ₀² t) is continuous, strictly positive, and F_t-adapted. Done in 4d9d645.

nodes.label: predictable cutoff of a continuous adapted process (4d9d645)
nodes.detail: Dyadic left-endpoint approximations converge pathwise to the (0,T] cutoff of a continuous adapted process, hence that cutoff is predictable. Done in 4d9d645.

nodes.label: sAdmissible_doublingH, H S σ₀ = K (4d9d645)
nodes.detail: The transferred integrand H=K/(Sσ₀) is predictable and S-admissible for the closed-form BS price, and H S σ₀ equals K. Done in 4d9d645.

nodes.label: not_literal_nflvr / not_terminal_bdd_nflvr (4d9d645)
nodes.detail: Black–Scholes transfer H=K/(Sσ₀): the same doubling wealth is an admissible Itô integral in the BS market and ends at V_T=1 a.s., so both literal NFLVR and the terminal-only bounded-below version fail. Done in 4d9d645.

nodes.label: theorem_terminal_bdd_nflvr_fails (b8ea73f)
nodes.detail: The same admissible doubling wealth ends at V_T=1≥0 a.s., so the terminal-only bounded-below cone also contains a nontrivial free lunch. Done in b8ea73f.

nodes.label: not_literal_nflvr_unwrapped / not_terminal_bdd_nflvr_unwrapped (7377f12)
nodes.detail: Unwrapped compared theorems use sigPrice of blackScholesModel, which agrees with the closed-form bsPrice on [0,T]. Done in 7377f12.

nodes.label: kitItoInt contVersion patch
nodes.detail: kitItoIntCont and kitQuadVarCont sit beside the existing kitItoInt and kitQuadVar (Carbon/Gemini). When kitItoIntRaw is already pathFiltration-adapted, the continuous version uses contVersion; kitItoInt itself is unchanged so StoppedKit and ConstVol still build.

nodes.label: Joint-filtration L² Itô integral
nodes.detail: L² Itô integral on the joint d-dimensional raw pathFiltration, built from JointElem / SortedElem, with the Itô isometry and π-λ density of elementary processes (Carbon/Gemini). MathFin's itoIntegralCLM is 1-D natFiltration only.

nodes.label: Riemann-sum L² bridge (lintegral_riemann_sq_le)
nodes.detail: u-cancellation inequality lintegral_riemann_sq_le and L² convergence of itoRiemannPrime to the joint integral on any JointElem (Carbon/Gemini).

nodes.label: Continuous L² Itô integral and Riemann subsequence
nodes.detail: exists_contIto_and_riemann_subseq: for predictable Z in L²(dtP), a version M of the joint-filtration Itô integral that is adapted and integrable, has mean zero, is a.s. continuous on [0,T] with M 0 = 0, is constant after q on {Z=0} after q, and is the in-probability limit of itoRiemannPrime along a subsequence (Carbon/Gemini, Mathlib 4.35 repairs).

nodes.label: Localization K^(m)
nodes.detail: Left-continuous raw-filtration localization K^(m)=K 1_{Q≤m} of an S-admissible integrand (pathwise ∫K²<∞, not necessarily L²(dt⊗P)): localizedK is predSigma-measurable, lies in L²(dtP), and localizedQuad at τ_m is at most m (Carbon/Gemini, Mathlib 4.35 repairs).

nodes.label: Bounded-below local martingale ⇒ supermartingale
nodes.detail: A uniformly bounded-below local martingale is a supermartingale on [0,T]. Localize V at τ_m, apply the continuous L² integral, and use Fatou (expectation_le_zero_of_bounded_below_local_martingale in NflvrCone) to get E[V_T]≤0. Proved as expectation_le_zero_of_boundedBelowGain (Carbon/Gemini, Mathlib 4.35 repairs).

nodes.label: satisfiesNFLVR_DS_boundedBelowGains
nodes.detail: Every G in BoundedBelowGains is integrable with E[G]≤0, hence SatisfiesNFLVR_DS holds by nflvr_ds_of_nonpos_mean. No H3. Proved for adapted, a.s.-continuous S and σ on the raw path filtration (Carbon/Gemini, Mathlib 4.35 repairs).

nodes.label: theorem_B_mp / unwrapped DS NFLVR upgrade
nodes.detail: Way A: IsSignaturePrice.doleans_repr is a.s. path-continuity on [0, T] and a.s. equality at each t to the Doléans exponential (kitItoInt / kitQuadVar). theorem_B_mp_unwrapped asserts SatisfiesNFLVR_DS for BoundedBelowGains of that S itself (witness sigPriceCont). Bundled theorem_B_mp keeps the pointwise SignaturePriceSolution from theorem_A and asserts DS NFLVR for sigPriceCont, which equals sol.S a.s. at each t. theorem_B_of_Setup_Ito_Riccati_Kit is unchanged (no MultiBrownian). not_theorem_B and not_theorem_B_unwrapped negate the same conjuncts. SignaturePriceSolution and theorem_A are unchanged.
